post.description: Single worker, no overlapping dispatch. Backend selects pending, calls allowlisted gateway/notification handlers, marks DELIVERED on durable responsibility transfer; failures backoff. Gateway config ACK only after apply; AI 202 not completion. Reconcile RUNNING jobs after process loss; no SENDING DB enum. Notification consumer creates inbox and DELIVERY PENDING intents, never performs external email/chat send; actual delivery belongs to dispatchDeliveryBatch.

post.description: jobs-worker only, scope jobs:deliveries:dispatch. Single Quartz DeliveryDispatch with shared nonoverlap guard for scheduled/manual invocation. Backend owns SQL. Outbox creates inbox+DELIVERY intents only; this path alone executes due PENDING email/chat delivery. Default externalDeliveryEnabled=false: do NOT send and do NOT mark SENT; due rows stay PENDING, delivered=0; optional skipped count not invented in DTO. Opt-in later revalidates recipient/current policy, resolves secret refs server-side, timeout/backoff attempts and SENT/FAILED. Crash after provider send may duplicate; no PROCESSING enum, lease table or exactly-once promise.

post.description: jobs-worker only, scope jobs:connections:watch. Single nonoverlap ConnectionWatch. Backend examines enabled equipment targets and COMM_LOST rules; last fresh valid acquired+received sample, not connector heartbeat/HTTP200. stale_sec20 default; if never sampled use activated_at_utc. ACTIVE creation/recovery and alarm/notification Outbox committed atomically, dedup by active rule. Suppression honored, disabling does not fake recovery. Valid resumed samples recover; out-of-order samples never reset freshness. No PLC control or execution-permit persistence.
